LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelDestination.description: A distant world tile reached by a rooted flesh tunnel.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelDestination.label: flesh tunnel
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelMouth.label: flesh tunnel maw
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelMouth.description: The distant maw of a passage grown by a tunnel node. Carries caravans and war packs instantly to the other end.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObject.description: A living moon that can move above the planet and connect to the surface through a celestial umbilicus. Requires hemogel; prolonged starvation causes it to fall.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonWorldObject.label: flesh moon
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonStartingSettlement.descripti: A hidden scenario handoff object used to let the flesh moon be generated as the player's first map.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonStartingSettlement.label: flesh moon
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonSurfaceAnchor.label: flesh moon anchor
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonSurfaceAnchor.description: A surface point pierced by the flesh moon's celestial umbilicus.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonCrashSite.label: fallen flesh moon
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonCrashSite.description: A surface scar where the starving flesh moon fell and burst across the terrain.
